$description: Component sizes. The diagram layout reads these at runtime, so CSS and layout can never disagree. Vertical sizes are multiples of grid.unit.

mark.$description: The square marking a wholly added or removed class

head-height.$description: padding-y + overline line + heading line + padding-y = 8 + 16 + 24 + 8

gutter.$description: Width of the change mark column

kind.$description: Width of the member kind column

row-bar.$description: Bar on the leading edge of a changed member's row

layer-gap.$description: Horizontal space between columns of cards

node-gap.$description: Vertical space between cards in a column

edge-gap.$description: Space between an arrowhead and the card it points at

arrow-length.$description: Tip to back corners of an arrowhead at normal weight

arrow-width.$description: Width across the back of an arrowhead

arrow-notch.$description: How far back the notch sits, as a share of arrow-length; lines end here

arrow-scale-strong.$description: Arrowhead scale for emphasised edges, matching edge-width-strong

dot.$description: Radius of a canvas grid dot

dash-inferred.$description: Dash pattern for edges not resolved from the code

dash-data.$description: Dash pattern for reads and writes

dash-flow.$description: Dash pattern for the animated flow path

dash-flow-period.$description: Sum of dash-flow; the animation moves by one period

detail-zoom.$description: Below this zoom, cards drop their text and edges join up per card, so large diagrams stay cheap to draw

zoom-step.$description: Zoom factor of one press of the zoom buttons or keys

zoom-wheel.$description: Zoom rate per pixel of wheel or trackpad pinch movement

zoom-focus.$description: Least zoom when the view moves to a single card

drag-threshold.$description: How far the pointer moves before a press becomes a drag rather than a click

edge-margin.$description: How far the painted edge bitmap reaches beyond the view, as a share of the view. Bigger means fewer repaints while panning; smaller means each repaint is quicker

settle-delay.$description: How long zooming must pause before text and edges are redrawn sharp

paint-delay.$description: Without a worker, how long movement must pause before edges are repainted on the main thread

font-timeout.$description: How long to wait for web fonts before measuring cards with the fallback font

large-graph.$description: Above this many components, the layout stops preserving the graph's order and sweeps less, which is about five times faster

narrow.$description: At this viewport width and below, the sidebar and inspector become sheets over the canvas. tools/lint-design.mjs checks that the viewer's media query uses this value.
